title: The Pit Gladiators
text: Damned souls fight in an arena of bone for the devils' amusement, hacking at each other with rusted blades, healing and fighting again. The winner goes free, they say, though no one in the stands can remember a winner.

options.label: The strongest steps into the arena to win what no one here has won.

outcomes.text: They win to a roar from the stands. The devils take note.
They lose, and leave the arena carried on someone else's legs.

options.label: Free a gladiator and deny the devils their sport.

outcomes.text: The devils are displeased. They come down from the stands.

options.label: The shrewdest bets on the fights, playing the devils at their own game.

outcomes.text: They win a purse of devil coin, hot to the touch.
They lose every coin. The devils laugh as they count it.
